snippet.title: Frozen Ship Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Frozen Ship is a narrative-driven adventure that blends first-person open-world exploration with the management of a city on wheels.
Manage your team, build structures, make tough decisions, explore, craft - everything is in your hands.
Beyond the ship, a procedurally generated world awaits with its own story and adventures.

Add to Wishlist on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/3423990/Frozen_Ship/
